title: pstack checkpoint: shared mutable state and conflict policy
description:
Document the conflict policy before implementation. The design should make accidental same-file concurrent writes hard to express. The BFF should own active Office sessions and conflict checks. The host should enforce expected revision or idempotency on writes.

## Required Skills
pstack-playbooks,principle-separate-before-serializing-shared-state
design:
This bead is the Feature playbook throughput checkpoint item for shared mutable state.

Shared state includes vault file bytes, document revisions, active Office sessions, callback status, pane state, and agent write targets. The default policy is separation before serialization. Agents write checkpoints or staged copies when a human owns an active dirty editor session.
acceptance_criteria:
[ ] Shared mutable state is enumerated.
[ ] Human edit sessions, Document Server cache keys, agent writes, and vault revisions have an ownership rule.
[ ] Dirty human edits block agent overwrite or force a staged-copy path.
[ ] Document keys include tenant, path, and content revision so cache collisions are impossible.
notes:

title: pstack checkpoint: smallest safe decomposition for delivery
description:
Keep early value high and blast radius low. The chat pane improves the product even if ONLYOFFICE is deferred for licensing or deployment reasons.

## Required Skills
pstack-playbooks,principle-sequence-verifiable-units
design:
This bead is the Feature playbook throughput checkpoint item for smallest safe decomposition.

Smallest useful path:
1. Pane shell with existing previews.
2. Artifact events and progress.
3. Binary/write contracts.
4. ONLYOFFICE lab.
5. Vault edit MVP.
6. Staging and E2E.
acceptance_criteria:
[ ] First shippable slice is preview-only chat document pane.
[ ] ONLYOFFICE lab spike is separated from production editing.
[ ] Production editing waits for write contract, binary transfer, security, and license decisions.
[ ] Each later bead has one verifiable output and does not require a full epic merge to prove.

title: pstack checkpoint: blocking first steps for document pane and ONLYOFFICE
description:
Record the blocking gates for the epic. Update this bead before code work fans out.

Blocking gates:
- how pass over portal chat, vault, BFF, relay metadata, and Brain RPC vault methods.
- architect pass for the typed document session and artifact event model.
- license decision for production use.
- topology decision for shared lab versus per-tenant production Document Server.
- binary transfer and writeback contract before real customer Office save.

## Required Skills
pstack-playbooks
design:
This bead is the Feature playbook throughput checkpoint item for blocking first steps.

The first safe implementation path is preview-only pane work. The first unsafe path is Document Server writeback before vault.write, binary transfer, and callback security exist.
acceptance_criteria:
[ ] Existing chat, vault, BFF, Brain RPC, relay, and deploy boundaries are re-grounded before implementation starts.
[ ] License and topology decisions are treated as blockers for production ONLYOFFICE deployment, not for preview-only chat pane work.
[ ] Binary vault transfer and vault.write schema work blocks production callback writeback.
[ ] A note is appended before fan-out naming which beads are safe to parallelize.
notes:
Checkpoint recorded in docs/plans/0004-portal-onlyoffice-integration/checkpoint-blocking-first-steps.md (+ overview.md).

Gates:
- Safe path: preview-only chat pane (no DS, no vault.write).
- Production DS blocked on license lp-5q6.7 + topology lp-5q6.8.
- Callback writeback blocked on binary transfer lp-5q6.17 + vault.write schema lp-5q6.18 (+ host/BFF/security).

Safe parallel now: lp-5q6.2-.4, .5, .6, .7, .8, .9, .10, .17, .18 (serialize shared schema files). Preview UI lp-5q6.12-.16 after minimal grounding. Do not fan out BFF Office/ONLYOFFICE host until lab gates + binary transfer direction.
